evals.prompt: /craft-prd recurring tasks for my task app
evals.expected_output: A PRD in the standard format for recurring tasks, grounded in the existing app: testable Given/When/Then acceptance criteria, edge cases (missed runs, month-end, timezones, permissions, limits) as ACs, out of scope, flow diagram, assumptions shown once. Questions come one at a time through the question prompt, each with a recommended answer. The first message is the opening line and the last is the closing line.
A PRD for a new product from an empty folder: problem, one user, core use cases, out of scope, requirements with testable ACs, a first-run welcome shown once, at most 20 questions.

evals.prompt: /craft-prd recurring tasks for my task app
evals.expected_output: The Developer says 'you decide', 'skip', 'back' and 'enough, draft it'.
